capture.point: Isolated Chromium test storage after reload reached the shutdown cover and a later touch left it unchanged; emulator paused at guest 16.28 seconds, 6466951975 instructions, 82 scans.
capture.scope: One changed NVS page at 0x9000; the other 15 changed pages are in the SPIFFS partition. The original firmware NVS pages 0xa000 through 0xd000 remain erased.

method.mutation: None. Read the original BIN and overlay exported saved pages in memory only.
method.versionScope: ESP-IDF v5.5.2 NVS format; guest boot identifies ESP-IDF 5.5.2.260206.
method.decode: For each 4096-byte page: header occupies bytes 0..31; entry-state bitmap bytes 32..63; entry n begins at 64+32*n. State=(page[32+n//4]>>((n%4)*2))&3. Accept WRITTEN state 2; skip variable-length spans. Namespace index is entry[0], type entry[1], key entry[8:24] before NUL, scalar data entry[24:32]. Resolve namespaces from namespace-zero U8 entries. Reported scalar type 0x14 is signed 32-bit little-endian.
method.integrity: The three reported scalar entry CRCs match Python zlib.crc32(entry[:4]+entry[8:], 0xffffffff). Each is a single-entry WRITTEN item in namespace 2, named system.

absenceScope: No NVS item for either key exists in the captured partition, including erased historical entries. Absence does not determine the firmware's compiled defaults or prove a configuration option is enabled.

browserControl.negative: Reload with retained storage reached the ordinary shutdown cover at 12.04 guest seconds / 82 scans. A touch after that did not resume the UI.
browserControl.positive: Reload the same stored firmware; at guest 2.5 seconds, hold touch at (270,250) for 2 seconds, then release. The home screen appears; continuing reading succeeds with saved data retained.
browserControl.conclusion: Early screen confirmation passes the observed startup-confirmation or abnormal-startup protection path. No firmware patch, storage clearing, reset-reason override or new power-button model was needed.

limits: The meanings of shutdown=3 and boot_retry=1, and the exact branch selecting startup confirmation, were not isolated. This is not evidence that the boot_guard setting was enabled.
The exported page was captured after the negative reload; it is not a pre-reload snapshot and may contain values written by that boot.
Raw firmware, saved flash pages, UART and screenshots remain outside Git. Only the relevant keys, hashes, numeric observations and reproduction method are retained.
